semantics.authority_rule: Registry visibility grants no asset mutation authority.
semantics.availability_rule: Missing asset is visible and does not silently resolve by fuzzy filename.
semantics.delete_rule: Removing a registry binding does not silently delete upstream/source assets.
semantics.duplicate_rule: Same filename never silently merges different assets.
semantics.identity_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Asset has explicit stable identity independent from filename/path. [2] Registry entry and logical asset identity remain explicit.
semantics.metadata_rule: Asset records media type, dimensions/technical metadata where applicable, source/provenance and optional rights/license metadata.
semantics.path_rule: Physical file path/URL is binding/location metadata.
semantics.registry_rule: Each managed asset is explicitly registered.
semantics.replacement_rule: Replacing physical asset content follows explicit asset update/version semantics.
semantics.semantic_rule: Asset is presentation/media data and does not define domain identity merely by use.
semantics.usage_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Pages/MetaModules/styles reference assets by explicit asset identity. [2] Style/page/MetaModule refs target exact asset identities.
